# DABAR (DaBarBible)
> AI-assisted Bible study and daily reflection app grounded in scripture (KJV). Ask a question, receive a scripture-grounded reflection, and save it to a private journal. Faith-respectful and safety-aware (not a substitute for pastoral counsel or crisis help).

## Key pages
- [Home / Ask Dabar](https://dabarbible.com/): Ask a question and get a scripture-grounded reflection.
- [Pricing](https://dabarbible.com/pricing)
- [Our Beliefs / Doctrine](https://dabarbible.com/doctrine)
- [Articles](https://dabarbible.com/blog): Bible reflections on common life questions.
